qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for transmission mounts (rubber) to body?
What screw size is used for the transmission cross member to body mounting?
What torque value should I use when installing the mount bracket to transmission?
Are the torque specifications for transmission mounts the same for all vehicle types?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, all specifications shown apply to 'All' vehicle types.

qa_pairs.question: What is the difference in torque between M10 and M8 transmission mount bolts?
qa_pairs.answer: M10 bolts require 42 Nm while M8 bolts require 21 Nm, a difference of 21 Nm.

qa_pairs.question: Which transmission mount components use M8 screws?
qa_pairs.answer: The mount bracket to transmission connection uses M8 screws.

qa_pairs.question: What section of the manual covers these transmission mount specifications?
qa_pairs.answer: Section 23-9 Manual transmission, subsection 23 71 Transmission mounts.

qa_pairs.question: How many different torque values are specified for transmission mounts?
qa_pairs.answer: Two torque values: 42 Nm for M10 screws and 21 Nm for M8 screws.
